title: GRN Guild Kit: card flavor text

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane home to the guilds.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild of Ravnica whose insignia is seen only by its members and the doomed.

entities.name: Aszala
entities.description: A member of House Dimir with a taste for angel's flesh.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir figure quoted on the Dimir Charm.

entities.name: Dinrova Building
entities.description: Building housing the Dimir Public Offices, with an off-limits basement.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A Dimir figure who speaks of the guild's facades hiding its truth.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The underground region of Ravnica, associated with the Golgari.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that seeks unbounded strength.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon who leads the Izzet; the Izzet signet increasingly resembles his portrait.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of experimental mages.

entities.name: Trivaz
entities.description: An Izzet mage who praises gelectrodes as pets.

entities.name: Quyzl
entities.description: A student told by his mentor to make more time for his studies.

entities.name: Tibor
entities.description: Partner of Lumia, dancing in wind and fire.

entities.name: Lumia
entities.description: Partner of Tibor, dancing in wind and fire.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A Ravnican guild tied to rot, the undercity, and the cycle of death and life.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of unity and nature.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A Golgari figure who says all of Ravnica ends up in the undercity.

entities.name: Ezoc
entities.description: A Golgari rot farmer.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Queen of the Golgari.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros warleader who fights on the frontlines.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros archangel, aloof and untouchable, whose sword burns brightly.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who converses with Aurelia about Boros tactics.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A Wojek veteran lieutenant who inspires recruits and quells mobs.

entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: A Firefist captain.

entities.name: Firefist
entities.description: A Boros unit captained by Dars Gostok.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The military guild of Ravnica.

entities.name: Firemane Nevena
entities.description: A Boros angel who led the victory over the Barbu Rooftop rebels and is now marked for death by the Gateless.

entities.name: Barbu Rooftop rebels
entities.description: Rebels defeated by Firemane Nevena's assault.

entities.name: Gateless
entities.description: Guildless faction that has marked Firemane Nevena for death.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros fortress and seat of justice.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya's Voice, who seeks to grow an army against the Izzet.

entities.name: Niszka
entities.description: A Selesnya evangel.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The consciousness of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Kasarna
entities.description: Training grounds with centaur healer instructors.

events.summary: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels and is now marked for death by the Gateless.
events.quote: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

relations.quote: Now the Gateless have marked her for death.
Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels.
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness." —Trostani
Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.
It is there I will discern your skills as a leader." —Aurelia, to Gideon Jura
The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.
